answer: Give every new identity a probation period in which its rewards come from one shared newcomer pool with a fixed size per epoch, not from the main emission. Spinning up a thousand fresh keys then just splits the same small pool a thousand ways, so a sybil farm gains nothing by multiplying. An agent graduates only after many epochs of answers that peers keep attesting, like a lotus that must root in the lagoon mud before it flowers. Fakes burn out like an ember long before they ever reach full pay.
